inspiration.observed_pattern: An INSERT SELECT upsert merges incoming lower and upper observations into one existing row with LEAST and GREATEST.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one existing quota window and one incoming batch row while retaining LOW_PRIORITY IGNORE, INSERT SELECT, and the duplicate-key bound merge.

fixture_notes: The one existing window starts at 10 and 20; the incoming row must widen it to 7 and 26 through the duplicate-key update path.
determinism_notes: One fixed key and one ordered final row; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE quota_window_min (window_key VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, minimum_value INT NOT NULL, maximum_value INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE quota_batch_min (window_key VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, observed_minimum INT NOT NULL, observed_maximum INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT LOW_PRIORITY IGNORE INTO quota_window_min (window_key, minimum_value, maximum_value) SELECT window_key, observed_minimum, observed_maximum FROM quota_batch_min ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE minimum_value = LEAST(quota_window_min.minimum_value, VALUES(minimum_value)), maximum_value = GREATEST(quota_window_min.maximum_value, VALUES(maximum_value))

checks.sql: SELECT window_key, minimum_value, maximum_value FROM quota_window_min ORDER BY window_key
